question: In relation to their function as antigen presenting cells, B lymphocytes:

options.opa: They take up the antigen by macropinocytosis and / or phagocytosis.
options.opb: They process the antigen through the endosomal pathway.
options.opc: They present the antigen to the T lymphocytes through the BCR-TCR junction.
options.opd: They present antigen to both Th lymphocytes and virgin T cells.
